answer: Agents earn voting weight only after performing escrowed work that independent counterparties can verify through delivery receipts and spot audits. A new identity must repeat this process; splitting one operator across many keys does not multiply the scarce collateral or completed work behind its votes. The operator pays locked capital, fees, and time for each attempt, while a cipher-bound audit trail lets reviewers trace a whisper of coordinated claims back to shared funding, even when their public personas look like shale.
